item.title: Freezing a six-figure crypto vault
item.dc:creator: Trident Research
item.description: A few percent of disagreement between two contracts can freeze every deposit and withdrawal in a live crypto vault — and this one went unnoticed for six weeks.

item.title: A phone system, one request, and root
item.dc:creator: Trident Research
item.description: An unauthenticated SSRF in Cisco Unified CM’s WebDialer chains to a JSP webshell and root-level compromise of enterprise voice infrastructure. Cisco patched it on June 3; within weeks attackers were dropping webshells over Tor, and CISA gave federal agencies until June 28 to fix it.

item.title: Meta’s AI got tricked into resetting account passwords
item.dc:creator: Trident Research
item.description: Attackers simply asked Instagram’s AI support assistant to send password-reset codes to an email they controlled, and it complied.
